lines.en: label dormwarssixniki1:
scene nikimeetup1
: There are people here, though. Hello. I brought the daughter you never wanted and her friend who intends to fight you for my hand in marriage.
: As if I’d ever fucking marry you, asshole! Who gave you permission to speak to me?! You’re still in timeout!
: Damn, girl. Ain’t you supposed to be in love with him? Let me take him off your hands if you hate him that much.
: No one gets to throw away my trash but me! Fuck off, NDA lady!
: Nee-chan, I brought the compress and water you-
scene nikimeetup2
: Oh, good! Thank you, Noriko! And here I was worried I was going to have to come look for you and find you ruining even more of my childhood dreams!
: Don’t worry. I found Ami so she wouldn’t be able to sabotage anything this time.
scene nikimeetup1
: Again! Do not speak unless spoken to! How many times do I have to tell you that?!
scene nikimeetup3
: Niki’s a little different than I expected.
: Noriko got all of the kindness in that family. Niki makes up for it in unadulterated rage.
: Maybe I’m just misreading the room, but I don’t think you should be referencing any form of adultery in the same sentence as Niki for a while.
: Are you absolutely sure she’s in the running? I know I’d never yell at you like that.
scene nikimeetup4
: You should try. I might actually like it.
: Oh, cool. I guess I’ll keep that in mind then.
: Can I yell at you too, Dad?
scene nikimeetup5
: No. Every time you yell at me, I just get sad.
: Aww. That just means you love me.
: And here I was thinking it made me a bad parent.
: You are a bad parent! And you’re an even worse boyfriend! Now get on your knees and-
: Nee-chan, you do know you’re going ballistic in front of a ton of admirers, right?
scene nikimeetup6
: Hahah! Yay! Fans!
scene nikimeetup7
: That was all just acting, of course. I’m actually practicing for a new drama I’ll be appearing in soon and my childhood friend over there has been helping me run lines.
: A last ditch effort to salvage her career after intentionally blowing it up.
: How about I intentionally blow your head off next, Noriko? That sure sounds fun, doesn’t it?
: A drama? I didn’t know you could act too.
: All part of the job. And natural progression for a star like me. It’s definitely not because I’m expecting to be hit with a massive lawsuit and need the money or anything.
: It feels kind of surreal seeing you like this. So you and Sensei have really known each other since you were kids?
scene nikimeetup8
: Sure have. Had our first kiss in my house and everything. Noriko can vouch for that. Can’t you, Noriko?
: I was either not alive or not coherent yet when that happened. I have no idea. I’m sure it’s the truth, though.
: Aren’t you worried that...people might see you here and...get the wrong idea?
: Zagull Throat Spear is right. We could be in the early stages of a brand new scandal right now.
: Interesting name. And no, I’m not worried.

: For in rearranging my priorities, I’ve decided that I’m now going to be involved in all of your lives as well simply because I know it will make life harder for the Arakawas and that is now my mission on this earth.
scene nikimeetup9
: Wait. What do you mean “more involved?” I thought you were just making a guest appearance in the Dorm Wars to mess with Onii-chan?
: Right now, that’s what I’m doing. But who’s to say that I won’t be your new teacher tomorrow?
: Me. And trust me, you don’t want to teach them anyway.
: She has a point. We are quite the motley crew when push comes to shove.
: Either way, I’ll be damned if I’m going to be excluded from anything from here on out. And being around all of you is the best way to keep an eye on Akira that I can think of.
scene nikimeetup10
: Oh hey, yeah. Maybe I should start doing that too then? A little more time together wouldn’t hurt.
: No, it certainly wouldn’t.
: Nee-chan! You can’t just insert yourself into my class like that!
: Why not when Akira’s allowed to insert himself wherever he likes? Both literally and figuratively.
scene nikimeetup11
: Watch it. Y’all have come damn close to confirming a bunch of shit that shouldn’t be confirmed around me today.
: Onii-chan’s not legally bound to Nakayama Sister Law! Cozying up to my friends is a clear violation of Section 3, Subsection B-4, Sub-Subsection S9-571, Amendment 8!
: Uh...what?
: The fact that you even have the balls to speak to me about Sister Law after what you did tells me all I need to know about your legal interests, Noriko.
scene nikimeetup12
: The rest of us will be great friends, though! So long as none of you get in the way of any of my interests. Got it?
: She’s a lot spicier than you made her sound, Noriko. I like it.
: Well, I don’t. This is overstepping even if she’s just trying to get back at me right now.
: Why don’t you overstep the ledge of the highest building you can find, my precious little sister? Meanwhile, I’ll stay here and make everyone who loves you love me even more.
: That might work on Otoha, but it won’t work on Kirin or Yumi or anybody else.
: To be completely honest, I already like your sister more.
: One down, a fucking thousand or whatever to go. There are so fucking many of you! But what’s most annoying is how fucking cute all of you are! Hahahaha! AWESOME!
scene nikimeetup13
: Do I need to tell you not to take that the wrong way? Or have you learned how to behave yet?
: Don’t worry. I’ve learned.
: I understand it’s probably a...weird and difficult time for you, Miss Nakayama-
scene nikimeetup14
: Please, call me Mrs. Arakawa instead.
: I thought you said you weren’t going to marry Onii-chan.
: I thought you were going to jump off of a building. Proceed, blue-haired girl who I will soon win over.

: I...was just saying...I know things are tough for you right now...so it shouldn’t go unsaid how appreciative we all are that you’d show up here. A ton of us have been wanting to meet you for a...while now.
scene nikimeetup15
: Yeah, but the one who wants to meet her most just happens to be MIA.
: Uhh...I wouldn’t be so sure about that...
scene nikimeetup16
: Hey, guys. Sorry I’ve been so weird all day.
scene nikimeetup17
: I had some tea with my sister and her friend to help calm me down and I think I’m finally ready to-
scene nikimeetup18
: OH MY FUCKING GOD, MY QUEEN HAS RETURNED! AND SHE LOOKS EVEN MORE RADIANT THAN SHE WAS THE LAST TIME I SAW HER!!!! THANK YOU FOR GRACING US WITH YOUR PRESENCE! WE ARE NOT WORTHY!
: Oh. So you can speak after all.
: I BOUGHT EVERYTHING I COULD FIND OF YOURS IN THE MALL! INCLUDING ONE BOX SET I HAD TO BRIBE A LITTLE KID FOR! SHE CRIED, BUT I REGRET NOTHING! MY LIFE IS YOURS TO TAKE! I LOVE YOU!
: So, in the industry, we have a special for word for fans like Chika.
: Is the word “insane?”
: It is actually, yeah.
: That’s very sweet of you, Chika. I can sign it for you if you bring it to me, you know.
: JUST CARVE YOUR NAME INTO MY WRISTS INSTEAD! DEEP ENOUGH THAT IT STAYS THERE FOREVER!
: Uhhh...no. That, I will not do.
: Give the girl some space, please. Security would have had you in a chokehold by now.
scene nikimeetup19
: GIRL?! YOU DARE TO CALL THE NIKI NAKAYAMA A MERE GIRL?! I SHOULD PULL EVERY VEIN FROM YOUR BODY AND STRANGLE YOU WITH THEM, YOU FUCKING BITCH!
: Haven’t you been calling her “Girl” all day long? It’s been like the only word you can say.
scene nikimeetup20
: LIES! I CAN SAY ALL KINDS OF WORDS! BUFFALO! WINGDINGS! SEE?! JUST GIVE ME A WORD AND I’LL SAY IT! GIVE ME TEN WORDS! A HUNDRED! I’LL WRITE YOU AN ESSAY! PLEASE CALL ME CUTE AGAIN! PLEASE!
scene nikimeetup21
: Okay, new plan. Everybody out except for Chika and me. I need to have a talk with her in private.
: PRIVATE?! DID YOU BRING A COSTUME?! ARE YOU PERFORMING FOR ME?! BECAUSE YOU DON’T HAVE TO! I’LL LOVE YOU NO MATTER WHAT! PLEASE DO IT, THOUGH! I’LL DIE! BUT IN A GOOD WAY!
: You sure about this, Niki? You don’t want someone to stick around and, like...make sure she doesn’t kill you or anything?
scene nikimeetup22
: Aww, are you worried about me?
: Yes. And I am not exactly trying to hide that. Chika is literally insane right now. And you picked probably the worst time in her life to appear before her.
: LIES! THERE’S NEVER BEEN A BETTER TIME THAN THIS! I’M MORE ALERT THAN I’VE EVER BEEN BEFORE! MY WHOLE LIFE HAS BEEN A PUSH TOWARD THIS EXACT MOMENT! I’M FINALLY FREE!
: I’ve got this, Otoha. Don’t worry.
: Could you at least keep Akira around? It might be easier getting through to her if-
: I already tried talking to her with him around and it didn’t help at all. Besides, I don’t think I’d be able to say all I want to say with him in the room.
: Could you keep an eye on him, though? Without kissing him preferably.
: That would be like kissing my brother.
: That’s the best part.
scene nikimeetup23
: Yup. I’m leaving. Don’t die, please.
: I wouldn’t plan on it.
scene black
: NDA lady! Take your students and- hey, where’d she go?
: Miss Imai stepped out a second or two after Chika showed up. Presumably to call the police and report an imminent threat of some sort.
: Chika ain’t gonna do shit. She’s just high on...girl or whatever happens to you fucking lesbians.
: Why would you say that in response to me? I’m one of the few people in this class who isn’t attracted to girls.
: Oh, my bad. I just kind of assume you’re all gay until proven otherwise.
: How...do I prove that?
: Who’s the next one in charge then?! Someone needs to get these girls out of here!
: I think that’d be me. But you told me not to speak to you, so-
: This is obviously an exception! Get them out of here so I can talk to a third girl alone tonight!
: My point’s not at risk, is it?! Because I know I said I didn’t want it earlier, but I kind of do now!
: It’s the same point either way...you’re on the same floor.
: Ah! Guys! Io finally spoke to me! Did anyone else- gah!
: Come on, Rin.
: Let’s leave the two of them alone for now...
scene nikimeetup24
: I can’t believe it...I’m alone in a room with Niki! Do you have any idea how many times I’ve dreamed about this exact thing?! Because I don’t! I’ve lost count!
: Just take however many dreams I’ve had and multiply it by four! That seems only fair since there’s more than one of you sometimes! I can’t believe this is actually happening!
: So you’re really one of my biggest fans, huh?
: ONE OF?! I am THE biggest fan! I live, breathe, and SLEEP Niki. I would do ANYTHING for you! Just name it! Please! Let me be of use!
: And if nothing I can do is of use, I give you FULL permission to use me however you want! I can handle pain! I like pain! I WILL GLADLY BE YOUR PUNCHING BAG.
: I want you to stop fucking my boyfriend.
scene nikimeetup25
: Don’t play dumb with me. I’ve been watching him my whole life. I know his tells and I picked up on it the second he looked at you.

: In the past, I’d have just ignored something like that. But things are different now. And I’m not about to let some random teenager steal my thunder and my man while pretending to be my biggest fan.
: So if you really love me, you’ll fuck off and leave him alone. Do that and I’ll sign anything you want for the rest of forever.
: Hell, I’ll even give you a lock of my hair to sniff before you go to sleep or something. People like you want things like that, right?
: People...like me?
: Obsessive. Creepy.
scene nikimeetup26
: C...Creepy?...
: Don’t get me wrong. I’m flattered. And I’m sure you love my music just as much as you love me.
: But if you can’t figure out how to turn it down, can you really say you’re my biggest fan of all? Aren’t you being, like, super inconsiderate of my feelings and comfort right now?
: I...I’m sorry...I wasn’t trying to...be weird...I just...
scene nikimeetup27

: It’s fine. I’m more or less used to it by now. I’ve done plenty of meet and greets in the past, though. And I’m normally really good with faces, but I don’t seem to remember yours. This really is your first time, huh?
: I...I haven’t ever had much money and-
: You haven’t ever had much money and somehow went out of your way to buy out everything you could find of mine at the mall? Isn’t that, like...really irresponsible?
scene nikimeetup28
: I...I have it now! I got a new job! At the same maid cafe you did a promotional event at back when-
: Save it. I don’t need to hear your story. Just let me know if you’ll do what I say and I can get back to becoming acquainted with the rest of your class.
: Fine! I’ll do it! I’ll stop seeing him! There’s somebody else I like anyway! You just helped make up my mind for me!
scene nikimeetup29
: OH, GET A FUCKING GRIP, YOU IDIOT! WHAT KIND OF HALF-HEARTED, WEAK-WILLED EXCUSE FOR A GIRL GIVES UP ON HER LOVE THAT EASILY?!

: HAVE YOU LEARNED NOTHING FROM MY MUSIC?! ARE YOU EVEN LISTENING?! DO YOU REALLY THINK I’D BE WHERE I AM TODAY IF I WAS AS FUCKING PATHETIC AS YOU?! FUCK NO! I’M HERE BECAUSE I TRIED! BECAUSE I GAVE A SHIT!
scene nikimeetup30
: And right now, there is another girl right down the hall, ready to take a leap of faith and risk breaking her pathetic little heart for something you already have, but are now itching to give away.

: Is this really what you want to be? Who you want to be? Someone who lets a person you only know through a fucking screen tell you what to do and how to think? I’m not your fucking god. I am an idol.
: Does the me you’ve manufactured speak like this? Does she yell at her fans? Is she getting raw-dogged by a massive dick every night after drowning her sorrows in alcohol? No!
: Because you don’t know me. You just think you do.

: And you’ve fallen so deep into that pit of blind ideology that you’re now little more than another face in a crowd of millions with your mouth open and your tongue out, trying to catch my sweat and my tears on your tongue like they’re fucking snowflakes.
: I...I don’t understand what you want...I can’t tell what you...want me to do...
: Well then join the fucking club because I don’t know either anymore. I just know that seeing you throw away something so big just because I told you to pisses me the fuck off.
scene nikimeetup31
: Now, be honest. Do you love him or not?
: Does that even make a difference?...
scene nikimeetup32
: Because if...if you two are really childhood friends...and I have to compete against you? What the fucking...fuck am I supposed to do about that? Huh?!
: I can’t win! You said it yourself! I’m just some random teenager!
: And that’s all you’ll ever be unless you man the fuck up and do something about it.
: So you want me to keep fucking him then? And this is some kind of...weird, motivational speech that I’m just too dumb to understand?

: It’s a wake-up call. I could not give less of a shit about your motivations. And if I found out tomorrow that you moved away and cut all ties with Akira, I would jump for joy at culling even one member of your obnoxious hormonal herd.
scene nikimeetup33
: I really do love you...Niki...
: Like, you don’t understand. Your music...your face...it’s all gotten me through so much and...and even if that’s all by design, was it or was it not designed to help girls like me?!

: I’m not some bandwagon fangirl! I scribble your lyrics in my notebooks at school! I’ve even been thinking about getting some of them tattooed on me once I’m old enough to...That’s how serious I am about you.
: And still, you stand there and say things like “my notebook at school” or “when I’m old enough” with complete disregard for how that makes me feel.
: The boy I have loved for longer than you have been alive has been sleeping with someone like you for God knows how long. And you think you’re the insignificant one here?
: I...I don’t know what to...
: Telling you to stop was supposed to snap you the fuck out of this fucking nonsense. Not get you to cave immediately.
: You had a chance to impress me and you fucking blew it, Chika. You’re no different from anyone else who jots my lyrics down in a notebook without actually thinking about them.
scene nikimeetup34
: I am, though! You don’t understand!
: Then fucking prove it and fucking make me!
: I don’t know how! Everything’s been so fucking confusing lately! And I thought this was going to be the moment to turn it all around, but apparently that was wrong too!
: You don’t know that yet! You don’t fucking know that!
scene nikimeetup35
: Because it very well could be...
: And part of me wants it to be because, when I look at pieces of shit like you desperately trying to keep it together, it reminds me of myself when I was your age.
: None of this would have ever happened if Akira didn’t run away from me. Him shattering my heart into a million pieces gave me the spite and the fuel I needed to rebuild myself from the ground up.
: And while I can’t imagine this will do even half the damage to you that Akira did to me, I hope it does something.
: This world needs more idols. More people to lift the spirits of others when there is so much pain everywhere we look. So do that for me if anything. That’s how you can make me happy.
: But...But Sensei...
scene nikimeetup36

: Oh, fuck that guy! This isn’t about him anymore! If he wants to have sex with you, he’s going to have sex with you whether either one of us wants him to or not! That’s just how it works and I fucking hate it!
: But...I...I don’t want to hurt you...any more than you’ve already been hurt.
scene nikimeetup37
: Chika, I can guarantee you that nothing you do is going to hurt me. You’re just another bump in the road as far as I’m concerned.
: Do I want you to have less sex with my boyfriend? Yes. Obviously. But a want is just a want unless you make it happen. And despite what you might believe, I can’t tell you what to do.
scene nikimeetup38
: Now what? If you’re waiting for me to give you a handkerchief or something, it’s not going to happen.
: It’s stupid...don’t worry about it...
: I just...really fucked this up...is all...
scene nikimeetup39
: It’s kind of...funny, actually...heheh...
: I’ve, like...practiced for this moment.
: I had it all planned out...every single question and statement. The things I’d say to clearly get it across to you just how...monumental you’ve been in my development.
: I can’t remember any of it...
: Not a single word...
: I practiced so many times...
: Well, you can take solace in knowing this won’t be the last time you see me. So maybe you’ll figure it out one day.
scene nikimeetup40
: You mean I’ll...see you again?
: My days as the Niki of your dreams are numbered. And I’m going to be more present in Akira’s life from now on so, chances are, we’ll be bumping into each other every once in a while.
: I’m not sure...how to face you when that happens...
: I feel like I fucked everything up today.
: Could’ve been worse. At least you didn’t fuck him in front of me.
: I would never.
: Good.
: Unless you asked me to.
scene nikimeetup41
: Out.
: Yeah, I’m going.
scene nikimeetup42
: One last thing, though...
: Make it quick. I’ve been on my feet all day and I’d very much like to go drown myself in the bath.
: I’m going to follow my heart...like you said.
: And I still don’t think I have a chance to beat you, but...I’m going to give it my all.
: So what you’re telling me is you’re going to keep fucking my boyfriend.
: You’re more than welcome to join us if that-
scene nikimeetup41
: Out.
: Okay. I will go away forever now.
scene black
